payload.credit_html: Xing H, Wang D, Han F, Sullivan C, Ma Q, et al. (2014) A New Basal Hadrosauroid Dinosaur (Dinosauria: Ornithopoda) with Transitional Features from the Late Cretaceous of Henan Province, China. PLoS ONE 9(6): e98821. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0098821
payload.description_html: Strict consensus of 54 most parsimonious trees resulting from the maximum parsimony analysis implemented in the software TNT, showing the suggested systematic position of Zhanghenglong yangchengensis within Hadrosauroidea.
